top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Tech rebounds in the U.S., but Asia isn’t buying it yet
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq Composite gained more than 1% after last week’s sell-off, led by advances in Tesla, Nvidia and Alphabet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
